notes.title: Out of Your Mind: Milestone Update
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.

Dive deeper into this dystopian world with the introduction of the first [b]18 Steam achievements[/b]. Each achievement is designed around crucial moments and decisions in the game. From discovering every possible ending to mastering Mind Games with Optimism or Pessimism, the experience is now more intriguing. Check out achievements such as “The tablet’s glow was different?” (Ending) or "Don't give in to anger" (Successfully direct your emotions) to track your progress and choices.

We’ve also added a [b]gallery view of the achievements[/b], allowing you to see all available achievements and track which ones you've unlocked within the game.

To further enhance immersion, [b]6 new animations[/b] have been added, bringing the emotional scenes to life as the shifts occur.

Finally, we've addressed bugs and made various tweaks to ensure a smoother, more polished gaming experience.
